dba_findings.location: audit_logs migration L96-136 + z_reports/cash trigger migrations
dba_findings.observation: audit_logs gets BOTH MySQL AND SQLite triggers (full parity in tests). z_reports + cash tables get MySQL-only triggers (test runner uses SQLite, so the immutability is asserted via Eloquent-layer tests instead). Pattern is defensible: the high-volume INSERT-only table (audit_logs) has the strictest two-driver enforcement; the lower-volume tables get MySQL-only because production is MySQL exclusively (see config/database.php).

prev_hash CHAR(64) nullable (first row of chain), current_hash CHAR(64) non-null (mandatory signature). Indexes: (branch_id, created_at) for time-range queries, (resource, resource_id) for forensic joins, UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) for chain fork prevention. payload JSON column allows structured tamper-resistant evidence. created_at useCurrent() default (no manual override path that could backdate evidence).

dba_findings.location: z_reports migration design (UPDATE allowed by design)
dba_findings.observation: z_reports has BEFORE DELETE trigger only, NOT BEFORE UPDATE. Documented design: legitimate state transitions are open→closed (sign + lock totals via Eloquent UPDATE), closed→archived (FiscalArchiveCommand sets archived_at), cash enrichment (ZReportCashEnrichmentService post-close UPDATE). Application-layer signature verification (verifySignature L441-449) catches any tampering of signed columns after close. Pattern is correct: schema mutability + signed-row immutability via HMAC re-walk.

Bounded tail walk: DESC LIMIT $window (default 500) gets ids, then ASC walk via id >= min(tailIds). Both queries served by (branch_id, id) primary key + branch_id index. Keeps validator under 50ms even on 10M-row audit_logs tables — confirmed in docblock L114. No N+1: single cursor over the windowed range, computeHash + hash_equals per row.

Half-open interval (from, to] (lower strict, upper inclusive) prevents boundary double-count documented at L325-332. withTrashed() + withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope) explicitly includes soft-deleted post-allocation orders (NF525 fiscal continuity — P0-FIX-1/2 owner G0-A). whereNotNull('fiscal_sequence_no') ensures orphans cannot be silently included. taxBreakdownForOrders aggregates from order_items.tax_amount (already-persisted) — does NOT re-run PricingService at Z close (eliminates drift between receipt and Z aggregate).

dba_findings.location: audit_logs migration L70-76 + z_reports retention documentation
dba_findings.observation: audit_logs migration down() blocks in APP_ENV=production. NF525 / Loi Finance 2018 mandates 6-year retention post-close — both tables (audit_logs + z_reports) covered. No TTL/purge policy implemented (correct: retention is permanent within the 6-year window; archival via FiscalArchiveCommand offloads to S3 nightly per Kernel L216-225, but rows stay in DB).

summary: Schema and trigger design is NF525-compliant. UNIQUE indexes enforce both sequence gap-freedom (orders) and chain fork rejection (audit_logs). Dual-driver trigger parity covers test runner AND production. z_reports' UPDATE allowance is correct for state machine + cash enrichment + archival. TRUNCATE bypass is correctly mitigated at GRANT level (deploy doc scope). No DBA recommendations; KEEP-AS-IS.
